title: Normalized measured value report
purpose: Cover a server-to-client monitoring ASDU with a normalized measured value and quality descriptor.
expected_behavior: The peer parses a TypeID 9 normalized measured-value report for information-object address 3, including a normalized value and quality byte.
constraints_preserved: The I-format length 0x10 equals four APCI control bytes plus the 12-byte ASDU
The normalized value uses two bytes followed by one quality descriptor byte
The server-to-client direction matches monitoring/report semantics
The information-object address is three bytes and the common address is two bytes
issue_safety_notes: Ordinary valid monitoring structure only; no vulnerability claim, oversized field, or historical payload reuse is intended.
